subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the active implementation be narrowed to read-only pending-approval inspection for this issue, or should OpenClaw also adopt CLI-based approval resolution as part of the same operator surface?
rationale: The requested listing capability can reuse the existing authorized gateway method, but the open candidate PR adds state-changing approval authority and therefore changes the product and security boundary.

options.title: Land read-only pending inspection
options.body: Keep this issue scoped to table and JSON listing through `exec.approval.list`, preserving existing approval decisions on their current authorized surfaces.

options.title: Adopt list and resolution together
options.body: Explicitly approve CLI resolution after reviewing its authorization, audit, and cross-surface behavior as a broader approvals product change.

options.title: Fold into durable approvals work
options.body: Defer the CLI surface until the broader durable, deep-linkable approval design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/103505 defines the canonical lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Land read-only pending inspection
recommendation.body: Keep this issue scoped to table and JSON listing through `exec.approval.list`, preserving existing approval decisions on their current authorized surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects steipete to the central approvals CLI and documentation surface, and steipete has already supplied a source-backed review of the issue.
